# Effects

38 visual effects. Apply them to a clip (`clips[].effects`), a media layer (`layers[].effects`), or the whole video (`project.effects`). With Claude, use the `add_effect` tool and target a clip id, a layer id, or `"global"`.

```json
{ "type": "kenBurns", "params": { "zoomTo": 1.2, "pan": "right" } }
```

Parameters you omit take their defaults. Each effect compiles to an FFmpeg filter chain ([src/library/effects/index.ts](../../src/library/effects/index.ts)). Register your own with `registerEffect`.

## Color

### adjust

**Adjust**. Basic color correction: brightness, contrast, saturation, gamma.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `brightness` | number |  | `0` | -1..1, 0 = unchanged (≥ -1, ≤ 1) |
| `contrast` | number |  | `1` | 1 = unchanged (≥ 0, ≤ 3) |
| `saturation` | number |  | `1` | 1 = unchanged, 0 = grayscale (≥ 0, ≤ 3) |
| `gamma` | number |  | `1` | 1 = unchanged (≥ 0.1, ≤ 3) |

### temperature

**Temperature**. White balance. Lower kelvin = warmer, higher = cooler.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `kelvin` | number |  | `6500` | Color temperature in kelvin (6500 = neutral) (≥ 1000, ≤ 40000) |

### grayscale

**Black & White**. Remove all color.

_No parameters._

### sepia

**Sepia**. Old-photo brown tone.

_No parameters._

### invert

**Invert**. Negative image.

_No parameters._

### hueShift

**Hue Shift**. Rotate all hues.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `degrees` | number |  | `90` | Hue rotation in degrees (≥ -180, ≤ 180) |

### tint

**Tint**. Wash the image with a color.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `color` | string |  | `"#FF8800"` | Tint color #RRGGBB |
| `strength` | number |  | `0.3` | 0..1 (≥ 0, ≤ 1) |

## Grade

### lut

**LUT**. Apply a 3D LUT file (.cube/.3dl) for a custom grade.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `file` | string | yes |  | Path to a .cube or .3dl LUT file |

### cinematic

**Cinematic**. Color grade: Teal shadows, warm highlights, slightly crushed contrast.

_No parameters._

### tealOrange

**Teal & Orange**. Color grade: Strong blockbuster teal/orange split toning.

_No parameters._

### warm

**Warm**. Color grade: Golden, cozy tone.

_No parameters._

### cool

**Cool**. Color grade: Clean, blue-ish modern tone.

_No parameters._

### vintage

**Vintage**. Color grade: Faded film look with lifted blacks and warm tint.

_No parameters._

### noir

**Noir**. Color grade: High-contrast black & white.

_No parameters._

### vibrant

**Vibrant**. Color grade: Punchy saturated social-media look.

_No parameters._

### faded

**Faded**. Color grade: Matte, low-contrast pastel look.

_No parameters._

### moody

**Moody**. Color grade: Dark, desaturated and slightly green-teal.

_No parameters._

### bright

**Bright & Airy**. Color grade: Lifted exposure, soft contrast.

_No parameters._

### sunset

**Sunset**. Color grade: Magenta-orange golden hour.

_No parameters._

### matrix

**Matrix**. Color grade: Green-tinted digital look.

_No parameters._

### crossProcess

**Cross Process**. Color grade: Experimental film cross-processing.

_No parameters._

## Blur

### blur

**Blur**. Gaussian blur.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `amount` | number |  | `10` | Blur radius (≥ 0, ≤ 100) |

### sharpen

**Sharpen**. Increase detail.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `amount` | number |  | `1` | Sharpen strength (≥ 0, ≤ 3) |

## Stylize

### vignette

**Vignette**. Darken the edges to focus attention on the center.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `strength` | number |  | `0.5` | 0..1 (≥ 0, ≤ 1) |

### grain

**Film Grain**. Animated film grain noise.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `amount` | number |  | `12` | Noise strength (≥ 0, ≤ 60) |

### pixelate

**Pixelate**. Blocky low-resolution mosaic (censoring, retro).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `blockSize` | number |  | `20` | Pixel block size (≥ 2, ≤ 200) |

### chromaticAberration

**Chromatic Aberration / RGB Split**. Offset red and blue channels for a glitchy or lens-distortion look.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `amount` | number |  | `6` | Channel offset in pixels (≥ 0, ≤ 50) |

### glitch

**Glitch**. Digital glitch: jittering RGB split plus noise.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `amount` | number |  | `10` | Glitch intensity (≥ 1, ≤ 40) |

### letterbox

**Letterbox**. Cinematic black bars top and bottom.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ratio` | number |  | `2.39` | Target aspect ratio of the visible area, e.g. 2.39 (≥ 1, ≤ 4) |

## Distort

### mirror

**Flip**. Flip horizontally or vertically.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `direction` | "horizontal" \| "vertical" |  | `"horizontal"` |  |

## Motion

### kenBurns

**Ken Burns**. Slow zoom (in or out) with optional pan. Great for photos and static shots.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `zoomFrom` | number |  | `1` | Start zoom (1 = no zoom) (≥ 1, ≤ 3) |
| `zoomTo` | number |  | `1.2` | End zoom (≥ 1, ≤ 3) |
| `pan` | "center" \| "left" \| "right" \| "up" \| "down" |  | `"center"` |  |

### zoom

**Static Zoom / Crop In**. Punch into the frame by a fixed amount (reframe a shot).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `scale` | number |  | `1.2` | Zoom factor (≥ 1, ≤ 4) |
| `x` | number |  | `0.5` | Focus point x (0..1) (≥ 0, ≤ 1) |
| `y` | number |  | `0.5` | Focus point y (0..1) (≥ 0, ≤ 1) |

### punchIn

**Punch-In Zooms**. Alternate between normal and zoomed framing every few seconds, the classic talking-head jump-zoom that keeps viewers engaged.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `interval` | number |  | `3` | Seconds between zoom changes (≥ 0.5, ≤ 30) |
| `scale` | number |  | `1.15` | Zoom factor when punched in (≥ 1.01, ≤ 2) |

### shake

**Camera Shake**. Handheld/impact camera shake.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `intensity` | number |  | `10` | Max offset in pixels (≥ 1, ≤ 60) |
| `speed` | number |  | `20` | Shake frequency (≥ 1, ≤ 60) |

### pulse

**Beat Pulse**. Rhythmic zoom pulse, e.g. on a music beat.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `bpm` | number |  | `120` | Beats per minute (≥ 30, ≤ 240) |
| `amount` | number |  | `0.06` | Zoom added on each beat (≥ 0.01, ≤ 0.5) |

## Time

### fadeIn

**Fade In**. Fade in from black at the start.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `duration` | number |  | `0.5` | Seconds (≥ 0.05, ≤ 10) |

### fadeOut

**Fade Out**. Fade out to black at the end.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `duration` | number |  | `0.5` | Seconds (≥ 0.05, ≤ 10) |

### flash

**Flash**. Quick white flash at the start of the clip (impact moment).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `duration` | number |  | `0.25` | Seconds (≥ 0.05, ≤ 2) |
